units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jonah 2:11">Targ. Jon. II, 11</cite>.
Targ. Job XX, 15 Ms. (ed. Pa.); a. e.—

<cite ref="Nedarim 49b">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tamid 27b:49">Tam. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מילי לא תִיפְלוֹט וכ׳</he> thou must not spit out anything in the presence of thy teacher (thou must suppress vomiting), except &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 112b:2">Ḥull. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>אגב דוחקא דסכינא פָּלֵיט</he> through the pressure of the knife it (the flesh) gives out (blood).

<cite ref="Chullin 112b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>קדמי ופלטי</he> are the first to give out (their serum); <he>בתר … פְּלִיטֵי עופות וכ׳</he> after the fish cease to discharge, the fowl (lying in salt with them) discharge, and they (the fish) absorb; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 12:13">Targ. Prov. XII, 13</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 114b:14">Yeb. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא פליט</he> is it likely that he will escape? <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:15">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>פַּלְטִי לי מחדא</he> I have escaped one (evil destiny).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:15">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> <he>חדא מתרתי לא פַלְטַת לכון</he> one of two (mistakes) did not fail you, i.e. of the two things you did, one must be wrong; a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 13:4">Targ. Job XIII, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00625"><he>מוּרְדְּקָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: same, to give out, discharge. Ib. XX, 15, v. supra.—Y. Taan. I, 63ᵈ top (transl. וארץ רפאים תפיל, Is. XXVI, 19) וארעא תפקידה תְּפַלֵּט the earth shall give forth her trust (the dead); Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ top; Yalk. Kings 207.
